content:
Swiggy Instamart made Rakhi Sawant the face of their Rakhi campaign 🙇🏻‍♀️🤌🏻

and this is why their marketing team needs a raise.

rakhi sawant + rakhi (the festival) + instamart’s quick commerce urgency is a pun so obvious, it’s genius.

great marketing isn’t always about being clever. sometimes it’s about being obvious in a way nobody else dared to be first.

more brands should be this unserious with their seriousness :)

we loved this, Swiggy Instamart <3
comment: The bigger lesson is how brands can turn cultural familiarity into recall without over-engineering the idea. The challenge is knowing when a simple association feels fresh versus when it feels like a forced gimmick.
